claims.evidence: The witness confirms they are used tires, but origin (imported used) cannot be verified from the photo.
Tread patterns are visible but no depth gauge or clear wear-bar indicator is provided.
Internal patches cannot be seen without photos of the tire interior.
The witness report explicitly states sidewalls are not shown.
Manufacturing dates (DOT codes) are not visible in the report.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the 4-digit DOT date code on the sidewall.
Photos of both the inner and outer sidewalls for every tire in the stack.
Photos of the size specifications (e.g., 205/55R16) for each tire.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest/least valuable common tire size.

risks.proof: Video or photos showing the inside carcass of each tire.
risks.if_unproven: as having multiple plugs or patches.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the tire size and brand markings on the sidewalls.
Photos of the 4-digit DOT manufacturing codes.
Photos of the inner and outer sidewalls of all tires to check for bulges.
Photos of the inside of the tires to check for patches or structural repairs.
A tread depth gauge measurement or a coin test in the grooves.
response.reason: The tire size, brand, and age (DOT code) are missing. These specifications are the primary drivers of value and without them, even a worst-case price cannot be accurately assigned.
